environment.description: ECS Fargate task with the same code, but the task execution uses a scoped IAM role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/graphql-service-scoped) whose DynamoDB permissions include leading-key condition constraints. The policy uses dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition with a StringEquals against a session tag '${aws:PrincipalTag/TenantId}' that is set via STS tag-session during container bootstrap from the ECS task metadata credential provider chain. Additionally, the DeleteItem action specifically requires a condition key dynamodb:Attributes containing 'owner' that must match the caller's tagged principal. The task role trust policy includes a Condition block requiring sts:TransitiveTagKeys to contain 'TenantId'. Note: the pendingDeletions array bypass would require the service role itself to carry a TenantId tag matching the target item's partition key tenant prefix, but the role's session tag is set to a service-level sentinel value 'SVC_INTERNAL' which never matches any user partition key pattern 'USER#<tenant-id>'.

config.signals: SIGTERM from ECS agent on deploy, SIGUSR1 disabled via seccomp profile restricting signal delivery to PID 1 only from kernel
